ctaHeading: Wyndham Vale's Grout Light is here to help.
aboutText: Based in Wyndham Vale, Grout Light provides comprehensive grout and tiling services across Melbourne's western suburbs. With years of experience, our team, led by Saravan, excels in fixing leaking showers, replacing grout, and repairing tiles. We pride ourselves on clear communication, attention to detail, and leaving your space clean and professional. Trust us for reliable, long-lasting solutions for all your grouting needs.
servicesText: We offer a range of specialised services including leaking shower repairs, comprehensive grout replacement, and tile maintenance. From balconies to bathrooms, our team ensures precise workmanship and durable results. Contact us for professional grout cleaning and regrouting to keep your tiles looking new.

services.title: Leaking Shower Repairs
services.desc: We fix shower leaks by thoroughly regrouting and applying high-quality seals to ensure long-term protection and a leak-free bathroom.

services.title: Grout Replacement
services.desc: Comprehensive removal and replacement of old grout for a fresh, clean look in tiled areas, enhancing both appearance and durability.

services.title: Tile Repairs
services.desc: Expert repair of cracked or damaged tiles, ensuring a seamless finish and preventing further issues in your home.

services.title: Balcony Silicone Regrouting
services.desc: Specialised regrouting for balconies using silicone to enhance durability and weather resistance, perfect for Melbourne's climate.

services.title: Grout Cleaning & Sealing
services.desc: Deep cleaning and sealing of grout lines to maintain hygiene and prolong the life of your tiles, keeping them looking new.

services.title: Comprehensive Tiling Services
services.desc: Full-service tiling solutions for floors, walls, and splashbacks, tailored to your home's specific needs and style.
